_howto: Drop Spriters-Resource overworld sheets here (their pages ask you to self-host, not hotlink). Then point a set at the file and list species slugs in cell order (row-major). cell/cols describe the uniform grid. Example: emerald Kanto overworlds, 16px cells, dex order.

trainers._howto: HGSS/Platinum trainer overworlds: list NPC keys in cell order. Keys used by the game: oak, girl, fisher, boy, girl2, blue, guide, hiker, girl3.
